name: ml-experiment-standards
description: Always invoke for training, validating, tuning, benchmarking, or claiming readiness of a predictive model. Covers leakage audits, spatial and grouped splits, metrics, reproducibility, and honest reporting. Invoke especially when spatial dependence, split design, or deployment geography is unknown; uncertainty is a reason to use this skill. Do not trigger for descriptive EDA or non-predictive statistical inference.
